It matches the OpenGolfAPI 'Web' card on every hole except 15 (402 vs 273). The site states 6726 for the Championship tees, but its hole values sum to 6855. Its Club/Member/Forward columns sum to 6310/5798/4962, against the stated 6316/5794/4960.

The page tee is a forward box on the W edge of the pond (272 measured, about the 293 forward tee); the OSM hole line starts 60 yds further N and measures 332 (= the Member tee). The championship tee is about 70 yds behind that, roughly on the line extension (estimated 38.00318,-92.80561, 404 yds, about 48 yds W of the 18 green; position not visible in the page imagery). The page plays hole 15 as a 273-yd par 4 (4-wood -40), so the play is wrong.
